title: H1: daily Coconala request re-scan (ids > 5307946); send proposals under PG-1
detail: Scan new public requests since the last screened id, apply PROPOSAL_KIT filters, send under PG-1 when conditions 1-7 hold (log each). On done: create tomorrow's scan task (not_before next day 10:00 JST, id h1-coconala-scan-<MMDD>).
acceptance: screen appended; proposals logged with --grant PG-1; next scan task created
